# mtl5_bench capability card -- jetson-orin

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/publish_platform.cmake from benchmarks/data/jetson-orin/mtl5_bench/20261111T193624Z/.

The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `jetson-orin` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 643 of 666 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 1.000 to 1.001 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). The largest outliers are the 6-thread integer gemm entries (i16>i32 about 2x, i32 about 1.4x slower in this session), which are bimodal per process on this machine (#785). Relates to #721 and #737.
